facts.text: Geographically, Monterey is situated at coordinates 31°26′37″N 91°43′09″W, in the west-central portion of Concordia Parish.
The climate of Monterey is classified as humid subtropical, featuring hot, humid summers and mild winters with significant rainfall throughout the year.
Monterey was part of the Louisiana Territory acquired by the U.S. from France in the 1803 Louisiana Purchase.
During the Civil War, Monterey helped the Confederacy by serving as a logistical hub along the Mississippi.
Monterey grew as a riverfront town tied to steamboat traffic that linked plantations to New Orleans.
Current flood risk is mitigated by protective levees like the Mississippi River West Bank system, though the area remains prone to river overflow during heavy rainfall events.
